newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet fuel for Nov.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy diesel, jet fuel for Nov.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy gas oil (diesel) and jet fuel for November 14-15 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo, a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 130,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and 70,000 barrels of aviation jet fuel.
The tender closes on October 23 with offers valid until October 25, the source said.

In its last tender, CPC bought from Shell 120,000 barrels of gas oil at $1.42 per barrel over Singapore spot quotes, and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel at 99.5 cents premium to Singapore quotes, for October 26-27 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
